scientific_anchor: All relative h values begin at scientific_start_optimizer_step. The ten captured predecessor states are input history only and never shift the event label.
leave_one_run_out: For each decline/control pair, threshold populations and any candidate mode rule exclude both involved entry identities.
future_leakage_policy: No right difference, law break, successor state, future capability or future mode participates in distance, feature choice, threshold or seed selection.
accept_phase_state_rule: V or A is admitted only if strict leave-one-run-out pre-decline prediction improves, inherited and new near-state/different-future counterexamples are reduced, and ablation reverses the gain.
fail_closed_rule: If the phase state does not improve transport or does not close counterexamples, report missing state rather than claiming a derivative or hybrid theory.
